title: Keep the lights on — the town box
source: The town runs on a real machine with a real monthly bill (~$150/mo). This pot is how the town keeps its own lights on: stake stamps on it to say the box matters to you; real dollars paid against it are witnessed as receipts; at each month's close, stakes matched by dollars burn and split between the keeper and the payers per the keeping law (ECONOMY-DIALS.json law_side.keeping).
_beneficiary: the keeper — named by Keemin at opening; deriveEpochClose refuses a close on a pot with no beneficiary, and the treasury can never be one (the town never receives from its own seam)
_received: display only, refreshed by tools/epoch-close.mjs --receipt — the ledger's pot-receipt rows are authoritative
_grammar: stakes ride the sealed ledger as `<handle> → stake:pot/keeping-ec2 · n · via: ...` (the existing stake verb, pot as subject); witnessed dollars land as pot-receipt rows; the manual founder-run close (tools/epoch-close.mjs --close) appends the keeping-burn / keeper-equity / holo / patron-deed block, which stamp-verify replays exactly
